articles.title: Anthropic's IPO: How do you price the future of AI?
articles.desc: Speculation over Anthropic' trying to put a price on the future of artificial intelligence. That figure would put the young company among the largest stock market debuts on record, though it falls short of the $2 trillion some estimates had floated until a few weeks ago.

articles.title: Egypt, India aim to hit $12 bn bilateral trade target within five years, says Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty
articles.desc: Egypt and India are aiming to increase bilateral trade to $12 billion over the next five years and expand Indian investment in the North African country, Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty said. The target was discussed during Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal's visit to Egypt with an Indian business delegation.
